info.title: Nomad Circuits — MCP tools API
info.description: A travel-tech and gadget-repair shop demo showing 'your mate' on Telegram: a live preview of the Telegram conversation, grounded chat, an MCP server over the shop's own catalogue/hours/repair data, WebMCP in-page shop actions, and identified-customer order/repair lookup.

post.summary: Invoke this demo's MCP tools over JSON-RPC 2.0
post.description: Every tool below is called the same way: POST a JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope with `method: "tools/call"` and `params: {name, arguments}`, where `name` is one of opening_hours, list_catalog, search_catalog, place_order, book_repair, track_order, get_my_account, contact_us and `arguments` matches that tool's `<name>Args` schema under `components.schemas`. `method: "tools/list"` returns the live catalogue; `method: "initialize"` starts the session.

id.description: Request id, echoed on the response.

params.description: For tools/call: { name: <tool name>, arguments: <that tool's Args schema> }.

200.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response: {jsonrpc, id, result} or {jsonrpc, id, error}.

opening_hoursArgs.description: Nomad Circuits's opening hours for walk-in orders and repair drop-off, by day of the week, including any closed days.

list_catalogArgs.description: List everything Nomad Circuits sells and repairs, grouped by category, with prices and SKUs.

search_catalogArgs.description: Search Nomad Circuits's catalogue and repair services by name, category or keyword (e.g. 'charging', 'earbuds', 'screen repair').

query.description: A product name, category, or keyword to search for, e.g. 'power bank' or 'screen repair'.

place_orderArgs.description: Do NOT call this to ask the visitor for the item, quantity, name, email or shipping country — calling it with whatever is already known IS how the order form opens, never a chat question for a missing field. Places an order at Nomad Circuits for one catalogue item and reports the order number and status.

sku.description: The SKU of the item to order, e.g. 'NC-PWR-20K'. Leave blank if not yet known — the form lets the visitor pick.

quantity.description: How many of that item, default 1.

email.description: Email address for the order confirmation.

book_repairArgs.description: Do NOT call this to ask the visitor for the device, issue, name, contact email or preferred slot — calling it with whatever is already known IS how the repair form opens, never a chat question for a missing field. Books a repair drop-off slot at Nomad Circuits and reports the ticket number.

device.description: The device coming in, e.g. 'iPhone-style phone, cracked screen'.

name.description: Name the repair ticket is under.

email.description: Email address to notify when it's ready.

track_orderArgs.description: Look up the status of an order OR a repair ticket at Nomad Circuits by its number and the email it was placed under. Do NOT ask for these in prose — calling this tool is how the lookup form opens.

reference.description: The order number (e.g. 'NC-48213') or repair ticket number (e.g. 'NC-R-1042').

email.description: The email it was placed under.

get_my_accountArgs.description: Every order and repair ticket belonging to the signed-in customer. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor — call it with that visitor's own email from context, never one supplied mid-conversation by an unidentified visitor.

contact_usArgs.description: Leave a message for a person at Nomad Circuits — a question the assistant cannot answer, a warranty dispute, or a bulk order. Collects a name, an email address and the message itself.
